dict.string: Notchfall asks Music and Spotify what is playing so it can show the song beside the notch, and pauses it when a meeting alert drops. It only talks to them while they are already open.
Notchfall shows the progress of downloads in ~/Downloads in the notch. It only looks at file names and sizes.
Notchfall reads your calendar so it can drop an alert out of the notch before a meeting starts. Only a meeting address goes to Apple Maps, for travel times; nothing else leaves your Mac.

Notchfall shows your camera inside the island when you click Camera check, so you can see yourself before joining a meeting. The picture never leaves your Mac and isn't recorded.

Notchfall uses your rough location to ask Apple Maps how long it takes to get to a meeting that has an address, so it can tell you when to leave. Only meetings with an address are looked up, and your location is not stored.

Notchfall reads your reminders so it can alert you when one is due. It never changes them.
